summary: Checkout errors in the 5 minutes before 16:32:31Z are caused by failing payment Charge calls: every failing PlaceOrder trace seen contains a failing oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge call (gRPC status 2, 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.'), e.g. traces 28787b5fff0694567b2b7d8b448d8c24, 57e3750158d8f4f8ba9348bb69fb6a6d, 2d30fbf5a81504307f9b5e7a241c9adf and 4877dcb551d9ba266086999e801213d6. Span metrics count 5 PlaceOrder errors and 5 Charge errors in the same window. One unrelated prepareOrderItems error span (DeadlineExceeded, trace 8fd8cdc55b88482d1ed0f7acda29f44d) was also observed. Apart from a rise in payment Charge server p95 from 7.1 to 32 ms, no material latency elevation was seen in checkout or its dependencies.

claims.text: Checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge client spans failed with gRPC status 2 and message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.' inside failing PlaceOrder traces 28787b5fff0694567b2b7d8b448d8c24 (span cbeff7af87875236, 16:31:44Z), 57e3750158d8f4f8ba9348bb69fb6a6d (span 33a226afca36fe81), 2d30fbf5a81504307f9b5e7a241c9adf (span dac2575c17e2f7e1) and 4877dcb551d9ba266086999e801213d6 (span 9c8b8a209308bcf3); the parent PlaceOrder spans ended with gRPC status 13.

On the payment side, grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge server spans are marked as errors in the same traces (e.g. span b5c7305619225507 in trace 28787b5fff0694567b2b7d8b448d8c24), and the frontend /api/checkout request in that trace returned HTTP 500.

Span metrics for 16:27:31Z-16:32:31Z count 5 checkout PlaceOrder errors, 5 checkout PaymentService/Charge errors and 5 payment Charge errors, and 0 errors for cart EmptyCart and checkout prepareOrderItems.

A single checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems span (trace 8fd8cdc55b88482d1ed0f7acda29f44d, span 7dd4b0d0056f53a7, 16:32:21Z) recorded a DeadlineExceeded error while preparing order items; it has no visible parent and is not part of any failing PlaceOrder trace observed.

p95 latency of checkout PlaceOrder is 92.5 ms vs 95 ms one hour earlier and of checkout's Charge client span 44 ms vs 42 ms; payment's Charge server span p95 rose from 7.1 ms to 32 ms, which stays far below the PlaceOrder duration.

p95 latency of cart GetCart (2.3 vs 6.0 ms), currency Convert (3.7 vs 2.0 ms), product-catalog GetProduct (1.9 vs 1.9 ms), shipping GetQuote (9.1 vs 9.1 ms), ShipOrder (1.9 vs 1.9 ms) and email send_order_confirmation (47.5 vs 45.5 ms) is comparable to one hour earlier.
The isolated prepareOrderItems DeadlineExceeded span is an independent, low-volume error and does not explain the checkout error increase, which matches the Charge failures one for one.

gaps: Full trace search results for checkout and payment exceeded the size limit; only paged slices were read, so not every failing trace in the window was inspected.
Payment server-side latency histograms (rpc_server_duration for payment) returned no data.
Why payment rejects the card token ('Invalid token') is not visible in the telemetry read.
next_steps: Have the payment service owner check why Charge rejects tokens (recent config, flag or dependency change).
Watch the checkout PlaceOrder error count after any payment-side change to confirm it returns to zero.
